## Summary / Résumé
Describe the change, motivation and user-visible effect. / Décrire le changement, la motivation et l'effet observable.

## Scope / Périmètre
- [ ] SDK-alpha machine
- [ ] Host-only prototype
- [ ] Tests or DSP analysis
- [ ] Documentation or translation
- [ ] Website / Workbench
- [ ] Build or CI tooling

## Evidence level / Niveau de preuve
- [ ] L0 — concept only
- [ ] L1 — executable host prototype
- [ ] L2 — automated host tests
- [ ] L3 — ColdFire target build and combined lint/link
- [ ] L4 — emulator
- [ ] L5 — physical hardware

Do not claim a higher level than the evidence included. / Ne pas revendiquer un niveau supérieur aux preuves fournies.

## Validation / Vérifications
- [ ] Exact test commands and results included
- [ ] GCC and Clang tested where applicable
- [ ] Sanitizers / static analysis run where applicable
- [ ] Catalogue, manifest and site validators pass where applicable
- [ ] French and English documentation updated or translation issue linked
- [ ] Resource bounds and API compatibility reviewed where applicable

## Risks and limitations / Risques et limites
List what remains untested: CPU worst case, aliasing, voice stealing, SDK ABI, emulator, hardware, etc.

## Safety and provenance / Sécurité et provenance
- [ ] No proprietary firmware or secrets included
- [ ] Source provenance and license recorded
- [ ] No unsupported installability or hardware claims
- [ ] Backup and recovery documented where hardware testing is proposed
